description: Free. Pass any signed Settled response (attestation included) to recompute its hash and recover the signer; tells you whether it is authentic and unaltered. Use when: a Settled answer reached you through a third party, a cache or a log and you need to trust it. Not for: answers you just received directly over this server (already signed and fresh). Use the full response object, unchanged.

document.description: A complete signed Settled answer, including its attestation block

name: settled_verify

hash_matches.description: Whether it matches the signed hash

valid.description: true when the hash matches and the signer is Settled's published key

title: Verify a signed Settled response
